followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this is a structured knowledge task (decomposing a topic into subtopics, mapping skills, and recommending courses), which leans on extraction/retrieval and summarization-style organization rather than open-ended invention. Petrel has materially higher scores on Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 78.5), Summarization (86.4 vs 79.9), and the general benchmarks, so it's the stronger capability fit. The query is warm and benign, so Lapwing's distinguishing traits—its aversion to harm-adjacent content and its appetite for open-ended creative work—aren't engaged here and don't favor it. Given comparable cost and latency across the fleet, I routed to the model with the clearer capability advantage for this task type.
